messages:
Maya: quick heads-up — opened PR to update privileged retention docs with a refreshed CLI export example and clearer TTL wording. PTAL: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/451

Liam: saw it, thanks. main callout: avoid phrasing like 'delete after X' — legal prefers 'retention period' or 'retained for X'. :eyes:

Maya: yep i replaced most occurrences with 'retention period' in the prose. left the CLI flag examples as `--ttl 90d` for clarity. @Natalie can you confirm that's okay?

Natalie: @Maya that's closer. please add a short clause about legal holds: 'records may be retained beyond the stated retention period if subject to legal hold or investigation.' also differentiate redaction vs archival. :lock:

Sam: small devex nit — the CLI example references `redwood export-logs --tenant $TENANT --since 90d`. we should show the redact flag that exists: `--redact-sensitive`. can we include that?

Maya: good catch. i'll add `--redact-sensitive` and an example for excluding request bodies: `--fields exclude:request_body`.

Liam: for SOC2-friendly wording we should add one sentence tying to audit events. draft: 'Audit logs that include privileged access events are retained for 180 days by default; customers can request extended retention via Support.'

Natalie: tweak suggestion: 'Audit logs that contain privileged access events are retained for a default period of 180 days and may be retained longer if subject to legal hold or contractual obligations.'

Maya: updated the PR description and the docs text with that phrasing. pushed a CLI snippet too — preview below.

```
# CLI export example
redwood export-logs --tenant 12345 --since 90d --ttl 90d --redact-sensitive --fields exclude:request_body > export.json
```

Maya: pinging @docs-bot to run linkcheck and linter on the PR.

docs-bot: linkcheck started for PR #451 — validating 3 external links and 12 internal refs

docs-bot: linkcheck passed; linter flagged one heading-level issue in privileged-logs.md (fixed in latest push)

Sam: LGTM from devex. one more ask: can we add a tiny note that `--ttl` controls exported object's metadata TTL (not the source retention policy) so folks don't confuse export TTL with platform retention? i can propose text.

Maya: added a short clarification in the CLI section: 'Note: the `--ttl` flag sets the TTL for the exported artifact and does not change server-side retention policies.' pushed.

Natalie: legal approves the updated wording. thanks everyone.

docs-bot: PR #451 is mergeable, CI green (linkcheck + spellcheck + tests)

Maya: merged the PR. thanks all :tada:

Sam: thanks — will surface the `--redact-sensitive` flag in the CLI cheat sheet too.

Liam: nice — filing a short internal note for SOC2 checklist referencing this page.

Maya: filing complete. closing thread.
